description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa SmartBackgroundChecks. Mtu hufuata hatua kwenye orodha ya ukaguzi; OpenOptOut hutoa anwani ya barua pepe ya mara moja na kubofya kiungo cha uthibitisho.
instructions: Search smartbackgroundchecks.com for {full_name}. If you're listed, open smartbackgroundchecks.com/optout and remove your record, using {contact_email} where it asks for an email. This usually removes you from PeopleFinders too. Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
